Number, date, identifiers, VAT and routing are explicit exercise facts; no approval or prepared XML is supplied.

Voice explains the observed progress. The checkpoints ask for purpose/source before starting and service/total/export decision in the actual preview.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The actual preview displays one invoice, its parties, line, quantity, price, VAT and total. The expandable table retains every field and source section. Native export checks produce schema-valid XML and a scoped export report only after a content-bound review event. The lesson teaches where to find these and that no issue, signature or transmission occurs.

The repeat instructions also mention readable PDFs/photos without pretending this text-source exercise verified native vision.
